items.title: Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward
items.summary: A judge allowed an NAACP lawsuit accusing xAI of violating the Clean Air Act to proceed, signaling increasing legal scrutiny on environmental compliance for AI data centers.

items.title: OpenAI reportedly lowers funding target for new round
items.summary: OpenAI reportedly reduced the funding target for its latest capital round, indicating shifting investor expectations around massive generative AI valuations.

items.title: I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could
items.summary: An independent builder created a personal AI companion device ahead of Meta's Muse Charm release, highlighting growing interest in dedicated consumer AI hardware.

items.title: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3
items.summary: Apple announced that Apple Intelligence features will launch in China with upcoming iOS software updates, expanding the company's AI ecosystem to a major global market.

items.title: Supersonic airliner in doubt as company shifts to powering AI data centers
items.summary: Boom is pivoting toward powering AI data centers amid supersonic jet delays, reflecting how rising infrastructure energy demands are altering company business models.

items.title: Anthropic VS code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours
items.summary: Attackers compromised Anthropic's verified VS Code extension on Cursor for nearly 12 hours, exposing critical supply chain security risks in popular AI development tooling.

items.title: nemotron-halloween
items.summary: Hugging Face listed a new Halloween-themed Nemotron project, providing builders with an updated community release based on the Nemotron model architecture.

items.title: Things That Go Beep in the Night: Agentic AI Joins the Search for Extraterrestrial Signals
items.summary: Researchers are deploying autonomous AI agents to scan for extraterrestrial signals, showcasing the expanding role of agentic systems in complex, high-volume scientific signal processing.

items.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
items.summary: OpenAI will support a shared robots.txt standard, giving website operators a streamlined way to control how providers scrape and train models on their content.

items.title: Community safety report and new protections for teens
items.summary: OpenAI expanded teen safety safeguards and violence prevention measures in ChatGPT, helping businesses navigate tighter compliance and safety expectations for consumer-facing AI products.

items.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
items.summary: Developers are pairing frontier AI agents with NVIDIA Omniverse to automate 3D simulations, accelerating development workflows for industrial testing and scenario modeling.

items.title: Granite Switch 4.1.1 — Update models like you update software
items.summary: Granite Switch 4.1.1 was released to enable software-style model updates, helping engineering teams streamline model maintenance and continuous integration in production.
